name: popsicle
headline: Auto-content marketing generator for business
short_description: Automated content marketing generator that uses OpenAI and web search to create marketing content at scale.
author: cherrylcherryl

sections.overview:
Auto-ContentMarketing-Generator automates the creation of marketing content by integrating OpenAI's language models with Serper API for real-time web search capabilities. The skill generates relevant, research-backed content at scale, reducing manual content creation workload. It runs in Docker containers and supports integration with backend systems through Docker networking. Teams managing content calendars and marketing campaigns benefit from streamlined content production workflows.
Automated blog post generation for content calendars
Social media content creation at scale
SEO-optimized marketing copy generation
Research-based content production with live web data
sections.setup:
No install command available. Check the GitHub repository for manual installation instructions.
`git clone https://github.com/cherrylcherryl/Auto-ContentMarketing-Generator`
sections.usage:
```
Create a 30-day content marketing plan for [COMPANY] in the [INDUSTRY] industry. Include a mix of blog posts, social media updates, and email newsletters. Use [DATA] as a reference for trending topics. Ensure the plan is data-driven and optimized for engagement.
```
